project.name: Customer Service Workflow Automation
bullets: Built an AI agent for online retail customer service that answers order, delivery and returns questions using RAG over policy documents and tool calls to order data.
Evaluated answers with LLM evaluators on real ticket samples before rollout, ran data access through Azure Databricks, and served the agent via FastAPI on Kubernetes.

paragraphs: I am applying for the AI Solutions Engineer / AI Enablement Engineer role. Most of my recent work has been sitting with business teams, finding the process worth automating, and turning it into a GenAI prototype and then a working tool. The thread through it all is AI that people keep using after launch.

Redcare Pharmacy gets medicines and health products to people across Europe, and healthcare is where I have done my most meaningful GenAI work. Bringing practical AI into e-commerce and operations there appeals to me. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to build our life in Germany together and settle there long term.

At United Health Group I built a LangGraph multi-agent assistant over medical-plan data that cut manual analysis by 98%, working closely with the business users who relied on it. At Viavi I prototyped 15+ AI applications from client requirements, and 7 of them reached production or paid client work.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Teachers adopt a tool only when it fits how they already work, and that is how I approach enablement. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
